tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: 依縣市、行政區或名稱搜尋長照機構。一頁最多 12 筆，回傳卡片欄位。

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: 以機構 id 取得單一機構詳情（含名冊欄位；不含 sources／note／person_in_charge）。

tools.name: list_city_counts
tools.description: 回傳 22 縣市與機構數（沒有機構的是 0）。

tools.name: list_district_counts
tools.description: 回傳指定縣市的行政區與機構數。

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: 回傳目前登入者的姓名與 email（需 Authorization Bearer／OAuth）。沒有則為 null。

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: 列出目前登入者的私人筆記（需 Authorization Bearer）。

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: 讀取目前登入者對指定機構的筆記；沒有則 note 為 null（需 Authorization Bearer）。

tools.name: upsert_note
tools.description: 新增或更新目前登入者對指定機構的筆記（需 Authorization Bearer）。body 最多 2000 字；status 可為 interested／considering／contacted／visited／waitlisted／rejected 或空。

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: 刪除目前登入者對指定機構的筆記（需 Authorization Bearer）。

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account_profile" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account_profile · Public sink: get_account_profile · Destructive: delete_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account_profile · Public sink: get_account_profile · Destructive: delete_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
